background.source: The Thorn Birds is a critically acclaimed novel by Colleen McCullough that has become a cultural phenomenon. Set in the Australian Outback, the story follows the lives of the Cleary family spanning from 1915 to 1969. The novel has made history as the best-selling book in Australian history with over 33 million copies sold worldwide. The Thorn Birds was also adapted into a highly rated miniseries, becoming the second highest-rated miniseries in the United States behind Roots. McCullough’s work has inspired other adaptations such as a musical and has even garnered the attention of the "Big Jubilee Read" list of 70 books by Commonwealth authors in 2022. This novel tells a captivating and emotional tale, without the themes of racism present in other monumental works of literature such as Harper Lee’s "To Kill a Mockingbird" or Scott Fitzgerald’s "The Great Gatsby."
background.target: Fortress Besieged is a renowned satirical novel penned by the well-known Chinese writer Qian Zhongshu. The novel was initially published in 1947 and is considered to be a masterpiece of Chinese literature in the 20th century. The story is set in China during the late 1930s and is a witty representation of middle-class Chinese society of that era. The book gained immense popularity after its reprinting in the 1980s and was later adapted into a TV series in 1990. Qian Zhongshu's portrayal of family concepts in the novel has been appreciated worldwide.
